residue_root_cause: individualize_source_descriptions selects only SignalSource{status:'enriched'} (imas_codex/discovery/signals/parallel.py), so members of a SignalSource whose representative classified underspecified are never individualized and never leave 'discovered'. The residue is the member set of such sources, not a stalled worker.
